searchText: Is there a way we can scope this around future merge testnets? We'll soon be running rayonism-style testnets, so highlighting what we think would be most valuable can help <@!300026497274478592> focus on that 🙂 Any good way to get the total supply of Eth on testnets? I've been looking around but don't see any stats pages that show it. It is a bit of a tricky thing as it involves iterating all accounts, so it's not really feasible to do over RPC. I can make a quick PR to iterate over the accounts in a snapshot, which should be pretty fast. Can do that tomorrow if that's alright Yeah that would be awesome thank you! <@!187490121698770945> I've never used this but keep meaning to: https://github.com/mandrigin/turbo-api-examples/tree/master/cmd/supply (uses erigon's staged sync) (maybe someone on the erigon team already has an instance w/ this enabled synced?) Here ya go: https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/pull/22795 On Erigon with the `--http.api` namespace `erigon` enabled, this script that <@!384267276867731456> wrote (I removed brownie) can get the supply on Mainnet. I tried on my Goerli node, but the `erigon_issuance` method didn't work. Perhaps someone with a node different testnet wants to try: https://gist.github.com/perama-v/7fe22a7094c0bb896d424e9d885bebe6
